name: quality-suite
description: Meta-bundle: the code-quality plugins that carry a MECHANISM, in one install — review and code smells, architecture principles with the evidence-at-claim Stop gate, testing, comment discipline (warn-on-write plus a narrow pre-write deny), secret-leak prevention, and file-aware skill auto-routing. The advisory disciplines it used to bundle — security, a11y, debugging, performance, resilience, packages, observability, approaches — moved to quality-principles-suite, so this half can be installed without their always-on context. Uninstall cleanly with /quality-suite:uninstall — removes the bundle and prunes its auto-installed plugins.
